text: Adjuvant trastuzumab in HER2-positive breast cancer is associated with a significantly increased risk of central nervous system (CNS) metastases as the first site of recurrence. A meta-analysis of 9,020 patients found CNS metastases incidence of 2.56% (95% CI 2.07%–3.01%) in trastuzumab-treated patients versus 1.94% (95% CI 1.54%–2.38%) in controls. The relative risk (RR) was 1.35 (95% CI 1.02–1.78, P = 0.038). The ratio of CNS metastases to total recurrence events was 16.94% (95% CI 10.85%–24.07%) with trastuzumab versus 8.33% (95% CI 6.49%–10.86%) in controls. No significant differences emerged by trastuzumab schedule or median follow-up, and no publication bias was detected.
